description.text: The Pokémon World Championships Japan Representative Tournament (ポケモンワールドチャンピオンシップス日本代表決定大会) chose Japan's players for the 2009 and 2010 World Championships, for the card game and the video games together. Its players, all members of the Pokémon Daisuki Club, were picked by lottery for tournaments in all 47 prefectures, and each got participation cards. The top finishers of its final in Tokyo got the trophy card set in an acrylic plaque showing their placing: 36 each year, 20 to card game players and 16 to video game players.
